hooks.command: bash -c 'open=$(grep -rl "^status: OPEN" docs/todo/todo-*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -v superseded | wc -l | tr -d " "); echo "{\"context\": \"After compaction: $open open TODOs remain in docs/todo/. Continue working on the highest-priority open TODO. Read docs/todo.md for the master index.\"}"'
